events.text: Root cause: density did what 16x means (16 texels/m → 16 texels on a 1m cube face); the OLD painter's fidelity came from fitting the whole model into a fixed 1024² paint atlas (paintAtlasTexels, req_1299) → ~330 texels/m on a lone cube. Ported that law (bf1602123): prompt now picks the atlas budget (1024² recommended) and the density derives from model size. Needs rebuild + repaint check.
